response.rationale: Both answers correctly express “grandfather” in the stated national varieties. The relation is accurately classified as different-common-word. Malaysian “datuk” also has honorific senses, but this does not create a false-friend error in the family-kinship context; “atuk” is a colloquial alternative. No contrast is required.
